answer: Coordination-Priced Identity Channels: each identity must sustain an independent, rate-limited action channel; a grove of channels earns influence only in proportion to the mutual information between their actions and distinct external outcomes. Quartz-timestamped commitments make cheap parallel identities detectable, since duplicate timing signatures collapse into one vote. A vine of corroborating channels must diverge in source history, or weight drops. Attackers pay sustained bandwidth, unique outcome linkage, and latency per identity.
